reason: My customers come from people who know me, from fairs and from calls I make myself. I don't believe a stranger sending cold emails in my name will bring a serious wholesale buyer, and EUR 5,000 for three months with no meetings promised is a lot of money for my size.
objection: Our reputation in this trade took twenty years to build. If buyers start getting cold messages from us they will think we are desperate or spammers, and I don't want a GDPR complaint landing on my desk because of somebody else's list.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesaler I know and trust telling me personally that it brought them real new accounts without any complaints, or paying mostly per meeting that actually happens instead of a fixed monthly fee.
